title: Sedona by Lynx — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Sedona by Lynx.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Affordable Outdoor." Specialty tier. Sedona by Lynx brings Lynx outdoor cooking quality to a more accessible price point. Same stainless steel construction principles but simplified feature set. Perfect for customers who want built-in outdoor cooking without the ultra-premium price.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Outdoor kitchen projects on a budget. Customers who want built-in at a Sedona price vs Lynx premium.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Sedona by Lynx:

• Lynx engineering at a more accessible price

• Heavy-duty stainless construction

• Built-in design for outdoor kitchen islands

• Step-up from Weber/Napoleon into the built-in world

• Lynx warranty and service backing
